symptom: The exported research-only reconciliation classifier copied validated boolean flags into a fresh array using numeric assignment. A synthetic inherited Array.prototype index-zero accessor (getter true, setter discarding false) changed a caller's decisionExact=false into EXACT, despite all five own-data type checks passing. Reproduced with Node 22.16.0 and synthetic flags; no private evidence or production behavior was used.
lesson: Runtime descriptor validation is not sufficient if a newly allocated boolean-flag array is populated through inherited-setter-sensitive index assignment. An ambient getter can turn a discarded false value into truthy EXACT even without modifying the caller's validated object.
guardrail: Write each validated reconciliation boolean into a fresh array with Object.defineProperty as an own enumerable data property. Regression-test all five false-flag priority cases under reversible inherited numeric getter/setter pairs, verify no setter is invoked, preserve all-true EXACT, and never interpret reconciliation EXACT as independent settlement authentication or scoring/production permission.
